label: The Port Desert

detail.note: Issue #46: less to draw (and run) the higher you fly. Read by src/systems/world/altitude_detail.gd. Each tier holds once the viewer is 'above' that many metres over sea level and lets go 'hysteresis' metres lower. off: render features (sdfgi, ssil, ssao, volumetric, shadows). hide: node groups the town registers (people = bodies, the cantina owner and their brains; props = lamps, banners, boulders). SDFGI goes first: it rebuilds whenever a fast camera moves, which is what made flying laggy.

note: IP-neutral. The world around the port, for flying: where the desert ends and the planet curves away, the landmarks set in it, and the height where the atmosphere ends. The desert's shape is the town's DesertTerrain (src/systems/look/desert_terrain.gd) and its mesas and hoodoos are content/look/desert_landforms.json; this file does not repeat them. terrain.extent = the desert's half-size (its own extent wins when the desert is built); beyond it the ground is skirt_height falling away on a sphere of planet_radius from curve_from. Altitude is measured above that curved surface, so space_altitude is the same everywhere. Issue #46: planet_radius halved (120 km to 60 km), a smaller world whose horizon curves in sooner, so less of it is ever drawn. Colours: content/look/world.json.
